description.value: BC Liquor Store Harbour Centre is a provincial government-operated retail outlet in downtown Vancouver selling wine, spirits, beer, ciders, and non-alcoholic beverages. It is one of 198 BCLIQUOR stores across British Columbia and carries an expanded selection typical of urban Signature-format locations. A touring cyclist passing through downtown Vancouver could stop to pick up local BC VQA wines or BC craft beer for an evening at camp.
